newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's COSAB appoints Bob Tucker new chief.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's COSAB appoints Bob Tucker new chief.

text.p: Standard Bank's consumer general manager Bob Tucker has been appointed head of the Council of South African Banks (COSAB) with effect from April 10, 1997, the grouping said on Tuesday.
COSAB said in a statement Tucker would succeed Norman Axten who has been the group's temporary chief executive officer since June last year.
"Bob Tucker is uniquely qualified to lead COSAB into the future and he goes with our blessing and good wishes," Standard Bank Group chief executive Mike Vosloo said.
Tucker was managing director of South Africa Permanent Bank until 1991 and joined Standard Bank in 1994.
